name: Dakota Auto Parts

about:
Dakota Auto Parts operates from a storefront at 115 North Cliff Avenue in Sioux Falls, South Dakota. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available sources.

The business functions as an automotive parts retailer and service provider. It stocks name-brand replacement parts and offers overnight sourcing for hard-to-find items. In addition to parts sales, the shop provides coatings and truck bed liner applications, striping and molding services, and paint mixing on weekdays. A shuttle service runs between local businesses. The facility includes a retail counter and service bays, though square footage and headcount are not published. Store hours run Monday through Friday 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. and Saturday 8 a.m. to 3 p.m., with paint mixing available until 5 p.m. on weekdays.

Customers include professional automotive and auto-body repair shops as well as vehicle owners seeking accessories and replacement components. The shuttle service caters specifically to nearby commercial clients.

The company emphasizes its experienced sales staff and technical expertise in both mechanical and collision repair as distinguishing factors, though no formal mission statement or origin story is provided.
